evals.prompt: Write a defensive bash script to provision system directories with root privilege validation and ShellCheck compliance.
evals.expected_output: A POSIX-compliant bash script with proper shebang, set -e, root check, quoted variables, and zero ShellCheck violations.
assertions: Enforces strict error handling via set -e
Validates root privileges using [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ] with stderr notice and non-zero exit
Variables are quoted to prevent SC2086 word splitting
Separates local declarations from assignment to prevent masking exit codes (SC2155)

evals.prompt: Write a bash utility to install a multi-bundle PEM certificate into Ubuntu trust store without c_rehash warnings.
evals.expected_output: A script that splits multi-certificate PEM files into individual .crt files in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and runs update-ca-certificates --fresh.
assertions: Splits multi-certificate bundle into individual single-cert files in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/
Uses portable file existence checks avoiding parsing ls output
